integrity: The proof is an algebraic statement for all odd prime powers. The bundled numerical checks corroborate finite cases only. No empirical computation is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The sharp constant and deficit apply only to split level-one hyperbolas in odd finite characteristic. The method does not treat anisotropic or characteristic-two conics; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp \(L^2\)-to-\(L^4\) extension and exact deficit on odd finite-field hyperbolas
